title: iSDFT: Information-Proximal Self-Distillation for Continual Learning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.24646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation fine-tuning (SDFT) learns new skills from demonstrations while reducing forgetting, but it always distils toward the full demonstration-conditioned teacher. This fixes teacher influence at the full-teacher endpoint, providing no control over how much demonstration information should be transferred at each prediction state. We introduce Information-Proximal SDFT (iSDFT), which instead treats the teacher as a budgeted source of information. At each token, iSDFT selects the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, yielding a closed-form exponential target with a locally determined tilt. To control cumulative drift, we further anchor the student to its frozen base policy. translated_title: iSDFT：面向大语言模型持续学习的信息近端自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线自蒸馏微调（SDFT）能够从示例演示中学习新技能，同时减少遗忘，但它总是向完整的以演示为条件的教师进行蒸馏。这将教师的影响固定在完整教师端点，无法控制在每个预测状态下应转移多少演示信息。我们提出了信息近端自蒸馏（iSDFT），它转而将教师视为一个有预算约束的信息源。在每个词元上，iSDFT选择满足预设教师信息约束的、与当前学生模型最接近的分布，从而得到一个具有局部确定倾斜参数的闭式指数形式目标分布。为了控制累积漂移，我们进一步将学生模型锚定在其冻结的基础策略上。在四个异构大语言模型骨干和两个专业化任务上，iSDFT在8个模型-任务设置中的7个上优于原始SDFT，并在其余一个上与之持平。（注：原始摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: iSDFT将自蒸馏中的教师视为有预算约束的信息源，在每个词元上选择满足信息约束且最接近当前学生的分布作为蒸馏目标，并通过锚定冻结的基础策略来控制累积漂移，从而在大语言模型持续学习中于8个模型-任务设置中的7个上超越原始SDFT。
en_tdlr: iSDFT treats the distillation teacher as a budgeted information source, selecting at each token the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, with base-policy anchoring to control drift, improving over vanilla SDFT in 7 of 8 model-task settings for continual learning in LLMs.
